native_live_routes.note: The full run had three Chinese-literal assertion failures under an English locale in the added navigation tests. Those assertions were corrected to the active language and the final 84-feature suite passed. Routing code was unchanged afterwards.

live_fleet.note: Raw prediction availability is not a claim that every prediction is displayable or field-accurate. Nonnegative ordering and stale-report rejection were checked.

earlier_dark_attempt.note: The track tap did not dispatch: both camera probes had no track action, empty vehicle, following false and pitch zero. The same app and unmodified assertions passed in the dark-only rerun.

ui.later_changes: Final walking-progress and provider-gap follow fixes do not change UI layout; labelled usability fixtures bypass provider ingestion and live walking matching. These actual paths are covered by the final native receiver/progress regression suite.
ui.screenshot_notice: UI fixture screenshots are labelled as non-live data and are not promotional assets.

verification.physical_frame_rate_heat_and_power_claim: No sustained physical-device frame-rate, heat or battery measurement is claimed.

handled_cases: Poor or stale fixes retain the last matched walking/cycling distance instead of restoring the original access duration.
Longer legitimate GPS gaps can rejoin the verified route; cycling never learns a pedestrian pace.
Confirmed onboard phone progress works without a selected plate and never invents a physical vehicle identity.
A missing provider packet can retain the same explicitly confirmed private phone anchor and camera follow.
Complete signal loss retains follow intent without drawing an invented position; manual panning still stops following.
Returning from route details preserves confirmed onboard follow through a signal gap.
Inspecting future walking legs does not reroute or overwrite the actual current walking progress.
Provider-expiry and long-outage timing transitions do not restart the full ride or count an unobserved arrival.
The journey card, stop list, reminder and Live Activity use one remaining bus-ride estimate.
Known schedule-based ride estimates retain approximate arrival clocks; unknown departures still do not gain a clock.
Bilingual walking/platform actions use the existing banner with a bounded ETA column and readable two-line title.

superseded_upload.note: Cancelled distribution workflow while Apple processing was pending; superseded by verified build 142.1.0. No claim that Apple itself stopped processing or that the earlier binary was expired.
